claims.text: The Assembly news notice created 9 December 2024 reports that King Tupou VI officially accepted the resignation of Hon. Siaosi Sovaleni as Prime Minister, announced 'this morning' as Parliament prepared to debate the no-confidence motion filed by Hon. 'Aisake Eke; that Sovaleni told Parliament he would step down effective immediately while continuing to serve as an MP; that the nomination deadline was 23 December 2024; and that the Speaker announced Parliament would reconvene on 24 December 2024.
claims.uncertainty: A news summary of the sitting. Its paraphrase of clause 50A refers to the Interim Speaker and the return of election writs, wording from the post-election procedure. It also says the 14-day nomination period 'starts today 9th of December', whereas the Speaker's ruling in the minutes counts from the next day; the minutes and the 10 December release govern. Only the dated facts are used.
